name: Perfect Secretary's Love
overview: The witty, humorous, and clear-headed Qiu Yu excels in the workplace as the capable secretary to CEO Ji Xiangdong. Unlike the workaholic Xiangdong who is not close to his family, Yu is optimistic and blessed with loving parents. The only flaw in Yu's life is her tumultuous love life; she yearns for real love and an understanding lover. Dealing with an ex's persistence and family interference, Xiangdong's hidden feelings beneath his cold exterior finally come to light. In the whirlwind of career and love, Yu chooses her own happiness.
